title: A closed or archived validation run leaves its slot reusable
description: Use a disposable gateway, run ledger, project and slots to verify that an artifact-only validation run's own unpushed branch commits are parked under a durable ref and recorded on the run, and its slot returns to idle: an archive after COMPLETE released the slot, the named discard of a run held at a refused COMPLETE, and the archive of a cancelled run. The same ticket's branch then prepares again on the returned slot, and a commit stacked after COMPLETE is kept. No operator runs or slots are used.

validation-slot-reuse.intent: Closing or archiving a validation run parks its own commits with SHAs and returns its slot to idle, so the next dispatch of the same ticket prepares.
